resources.string: When to save data
Save data now
Keep data saving on, whatever the connection is
Stays on until you turn it off, on Wi-Fi too. Use this when the network is not really free, such as a phone hotspot that Android counts as unmetered.
Turn on by itself
What arms data saving without you
Metered covers mobile data and any Wi-Fi network you or your carrier marked as metered. Roaming is the strictest: it saves data only while you are on another network abroad.
The keyboard fetches this even while data saving is on
The panel stays empty and offers a button to use mobile data once
The keyboard fetches nothing until data saving stops
Fetched on its own

Titles and thumbnails for copied links and scanned QR codes
Word look-ups
The definition fetched when you select a word
Photo backgrounds
Refilling the pool of rotating background photos
Weather chip
The forecast behind the weather suggestion
Exchange rates
Rate tables for the currency chip and converter. A few hundred bytes.
Add-on updates
Re-reading add-on repositories to find new versions
Started by you
GIFs and stickers
Searching and loading the GIF and sticker grids. Your own packs always work.
Web and image search
Search results and the thumbnails an image grid loads
Animated emoji
Fetching the animated version of an emoji to send
Downloads
Language data, dictionaries, add-ons and the on-device models
Cloud AI
Chat and AI actions that run on a provider\'s servers. On-device models are never held.
Data saving never changes your settings. It hides features while the connection costs money, and everything you chose is back the moment you are on Wi-Fi again.
Download on mobile data?
You are not on Wi-Fi, so the download uses your mobile data allowance.
Use mobile data
Download on metered Wi-Fi?

The download uses your Wi-Fi, not mobile data. Android counts this Wi-Fi network as metered, so the app asks first. To stop this question, set the network as unmetered in the Wi-Fi settings of your device.
Download on Wi-Fi
A VPN is on, and Android counts the connection as metered. Many VPN apps report a metered connection on Wi-Fi too, so the app asks first.
Download on a metered connection?
Android counts this connection as metered, so the app asks first.
Download anyway
Turned off on mobile data
Downloads are off while you are on mobile data. Change this in Settings, under Data saver, or connect to Wi-Fi.
Turned off on metered Wi-Fi
Downloads are off because Android counts this Wi-Fi network as metered. Change this in Settings, under Data saver, or set the network as unmetered in the Wi-Fi settings of your device.
Turned off on a metered connection
Downloads are off because Android counts the connection as metered. A VPN is on, and many VPN apps report a metered connection. Change this in Settings, under Data saver.
Downloads are off because Android counts the connection as metered. Change this in Settings, under Data saver.
